Hero.title: Pass Your Nail Tech Exam
Hero.subtitle: Start by Learning, Then Practice With Real-Time Simulation. NailPrep helps you build real knowledge through structured lessons + a realistic exam simulator.

Features.whySubtitle: We've built a complete platform that takes complete beginners and gives them the tools, feedback, and simulated environment to become confident licensed nail technicians.
Features.structuredDesc: Don't guess what to learn next. Our curated roadmap guides you from the absolute basics to state board mastery in a proven sequence. Clear text, simple examples, and constant quizzes ensure the knowledge sticks.
Features.smartDesc: Stuck on a concept? Our AI Exam Tutor is built right into the app. Ask custom questions, get instant explanations on complex procedures, or analyze why your specific practice answer went wrong. It's like having an instructor in your pocket.
Features.aiQuestion1: Why can't I use an autoclave for pumice stones?
Features.aiAnswer1: Because pumice stones are porous and cannot be properly sterilized or disinfected. They are single-use disposable items.
